name: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (a castle, a lion, a dog and palm fronds, within a wreath of palms, with the motto SEGURA TIENE LA PALMA).
history: Municipal flag of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria arms — castle, lion, dog and palm fronds within a palm wreath, with motto
